oldLoop:
(defn- gn-loop [M :vector-i64 i :i64] :vector-i64
  (if (and (< i (vector-at M MM-SIR-N)) (= (vector-at M MM-ERR) 0))
    (let [M1 (gn-ins M i (gn-op M i))
          k (gn-g M1 gn-f-skip)]
      (gn-loop (gn-gs M1 gn-f-skip 0) (+ i 1 k)))
    M))
newLoop:
(defn- sr-loop [M :vector-i64 i :i64 Q :vector-i64] :vector-i64
  (if (and (< i (vector-at M MM-SIR-N)) (= (vector-at M MM-ERR) 0))
    (let [op (gn-op M i) selected (sr-has M Q i 0) before (vector-at M MM-CODE-N)
          pre (if (and selected (= op OP-CALL)) (sr-state M i 0) 0)
          M1 (gn-ins M i op) k (gn-g M1 gn-f-skip)
          note (if selected (sr-row "SI" [i before (vector-at M1 MM-CODE-N) k op (vector-at M1 MM-ERR)]) 0)
          post (if (and selected (or (= op OP-FN) (= op OP-CALL))) (sr-state M1 i 1) 0)]
      (sr-loop (gn-gs M1 gn-f-skip 0) (+ i 1 k) Q))
    M))
(defn- gn-loop [M :vector-i64 i :i64] :vector-i64 (sr-loop M i (sr-pick M)))
